summary.prose: Building this Story is mostly moving existing code onto fewer, shared pieces and then changing three rules. First every plan task's handling of its scope is moved onto one function, family by family, starting with the two families that already complete so that their live runs show nothing moved. Then the plan walk's rule for the aggregate task changes so that a run with a failed task still returns a report, and the run driver and the daemon learn to record a run that dies and to recognise one that was left behind. It ends with live runs through the daemon for each family, including a search at larger sizes for a nested plan, and a comparison of four test suites with a baseline taken before the first change.

tasks.title: The aggregate task runs on the inputs that exist
tasks.summary: Change the plan walk's rule for the last task of a plan: it is skipped only when it consumes at least one name and none of the names it consumes was produced. Every other task with a missing input is still skipped.
